text:
Probably not a mistake. Cards are charged when an order ships, so an order sent in several parcels can show one charge per parcel. Two boxes with two charges is what we'd expect.

To be sure, check that the two charges add up to your order total. If they add up to more than the total, or you see the same amount charged twice, send me your order number and the last four digits of your card (never the full number or security code). Once we confirm a duplicate, it's refunded within 3 business days.
